zh.title: 達美航空計畫導入AI技術 盼提升五成利潤
zh.summary: 達美航空計畫利用AI提升五成利潤；以治理與試點為保障並支援後勤與維修
body: 根據達美航空（Delta Air Lines）執行長發表的聲明，該航空公司正計劃利用人工智慧技術，目標將整體營業利潤提升百分之五十。達美航空表示，人工智慧技術的導入將涵蓋公司內部多個關鍵營運領域，以協助提升整體組織效益與營運表現。
達美航空指出，公司將以治理機制與試點計畫作為人工智慧技術應用的安全保障措施。在相關策略規劃下，人工智慧系統將用於支援與強化後勤行政部門、飛機維修保養團隊以及機票價格制定團隊的日常作業與運作。

en.title: Delta Air Lines Plans AI Adoption to Boost Profits by 50 Percent
en.summary: Delta Air Lines plans to leverage AI to boost profits by 50 percent while augmenting operational teams.
body: Delta Air Lines is planning to leverage artificial intelligence technology to increase its operational profits by 50 percent, according to public statements made by the airline's chief executive officer. The carrier indicated that artificial intelligence capabilities will be deployed across key operational sectors to drive organizational efficiency and commercial growth.

Delta Air Lines highlighted that governance structures and specialized pilot programs will function as safeguards throughout the deployment process. Under this strategy, artificial intelligence tools are intended to augment human teams working in back office administrative operations, aircraft maintenance functions, and revenue pricing departments.
